mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a strong consumer sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when RSAFS is rising and UNRATE is falling.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong manufacturing sector, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO is above 105.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index indicate an expansionary monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is falling and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 5% and an increase in housing starts indicate a strong labor market and increased demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 5% and HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate indicate a strong labor market, which can lead to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS is above 140000 and UNRATE is falling.
